newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 240 bln yuan in bonds in '97-paper.
newsitem.headline: China to issue 240 bln yuan in bonds in '97-paper.

text.p: China will issue about 240 billion yuan ($28.9 billion) worth of bonds in 1997, the Futures Herald said on Monday.
China's Ministry of Finance issued a record 195 billion yuan worth of treasury bills and bonds this year.

The bonds would be issued to cover a projected budget deficit of 60 billion yuan and repayment of principal and interest totalling 180 billion yuan, the newspaper said, quoting unidentified departments.
The government's financial revenue was forecast to increase by 13-15 percent next year, it said but gave no further details.
